source_checks.finding: The Android phone and tablet view of "Add a contact" supports the steps: open the Contacts app on your Android device; the Add icon is at the bottom right; enter the contact's name and an email or phone number; tap Save when finished. The introduction sentence "Contacts saved to your Google Account will sync with Google Contacts and all your Android devices." is also on the page. The default view of the same article shows only the computer steps, so the Android view URL is the one that applies. The search did not return this exact address, but the fetch of it succeeded.

required_actions.action: Enter an email address or phone number
